sessions.summary: Formalized data ingestion pipeline DAG, storage selection (Unified MotherDuck), zero-infra orchestration (tenacity), env setup, and DuckDB 1.5.4 pin.
key_decisions: Use 5-tier pipeline DAG: Tier 0 (Root), Tier 1 (Identity/Backfill), Tier 2 (Prices), Tier 3 (Clean), Tier 4 (Views)
Store metadata (~50MB) and 2-year price history (~415MB) in unified MotherDuck DB (md:polydispute)
Orchestrate via pure Python main.py using tenacity @retry decorators triggered via Linux cron
Pin duckdb==1.5.4 in pyproject.toml for MotherDuck C++ extension compatibility
Created scripts/check_env.py to validate API HTTP 200 responses

sessions.summary: Verified Polymarket prices-history endpoint midpoint mechanics, 15-day range cap, dispute window bounds, UMA Rocks Tier 1 anchor, and Tier 2 user profiles.
key_decisions: Polymarket prices-history returns midpoint (p), not last transacted fill
Dispute price window bounded by [thread_open - 1d, uma_end_date OR now]
Tier 1 UMA Rocks consensus signals joined via keccak256 hash of ancillaryData
Tier 2 Discord user calibration filters out system accounts (UMA Herald)
